title: The Honey War
description: In 1839 Iowa Territory and Missouri argued over their border in the bloodless Honey War. Unclear wording in the Missouri Constitution, survey misunderstandings and a misreading of Native American treaties left a strip of land claimed by both sides. A Missouri sheriff collecting taxes in Iowa was jailed, militias faced each other, and legend says three bee trees were chopped down for honey. The US Supreme Court finally decided in Iowa's favor. Source: Wikipedia, Honey War.
